notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
After 2 years of hard work, we’re back with some great news!

We’ve made a video detailing the different stages of Gräuel's development. If you enjoy the content, we’ll keep making devlogs on our channel (we hope you like it, we’re excited to show you what’s next!).

Between October 28th and November 5th, a demo will be available. This demo is super important to us, as our main goal is to [b]get your thoughts and as much feedback as possible.[/b]

[b]THE MOST IMPORTANT PART:[/b] Our primary [b]focus is to debug[/b] the game as thoroughly as possible and optimize it for a clean, polished version in preparation for the official release later this year. 

That’s the news! 
Big thanks in advance to everyone supporting us on this project!
